digest: KEEP: duplicate registrations share one Set entry, so either cleanup removes the remaining owner's launch fence.
finding: Disposing one binding can remove another owner's launch fence
counterEvidence: The map-identity guard prevents an old cleanup from deleting a replacement Set, but does not preserve multiple registrations within the same Set.
A readable durable stop intent still triggers cancellation, limiting the lost-fence effect to the interval before that intent becomes readable.
recommendedAction: Track each binding with a unique registration token or reference count, make cleanup idempotent, and test that disposing one duplicate binding leaves the other effective.
